_note: Monthly inputs Jobber cannot know. Fill this in at month end, then re-run calc-commission.mjs. Until every field is set, the TMCP bonus prints as *prov.* and is not confirmed payable.

_fields.trafficTicket: true/false — any ticket while operating a company vehicle this month. Forfeits the whole TMCP bonus.
_fields.customerComplaint: true/false — any VERIFIED customer complaint this month. Forfeits the whole TMCP bonus.
_fields.vehicleAccident: true/false — any accident in a company vehicle, regardless of fault. Forfeits the whole TMCP bonus.
_fields.fleetGrade: A/B/C/D/F from the fleet tracking system at month end. C or below forfeits the whole TMCP bonus.
_fields.googleReviews: count of 5-star Google reviews this month that mention this tech BY NAME. Pays $50 each, uncapped, and is not forfeitable.

_reviewSource: Reviews can be pulled with scripts/gbp-scrape-reviews.mjs and matched on tech name — check the scrapedAt field, not the filename, which carries a stale date.
